name: rive-weapp
description: Run Rive animations in WeChat Mini Programs. A source-built, WeChat-native Rive runtime (Canvas 2D, no WebGL/SIMD) with native and Taro + React example apps.

riveRuntime.note: Fallback build (`npm run build:runtime`) repackages Rive's npm-prebuilt lite glue. The PRIMARY build (`npm run build:lite`) compiles Rive from C++ source with a WeChat-native canvas2d renderer (tools/rive-build). Both emit into packages/rive-weapp/vendor; run `npm run sync` to copy the SDK into the example apps.
